name: Day After Day
source:
Vera finds herself on the docks of Vadena, an island of winding canals and opulent wealth, after a savage attack on her ship that nearly ends her life. Left with gaps in her memory, she roams the island in search of answers.

Cursed to repeat a single day, Vera must uncover who has cursed her and why. How will you break the loop?

[From [url=https://hmoon-publishing-llc.itch.io/day-after-day]itch.io[/url]]
